gates.reason: DOCUMENT-ONLY here, but the claim is NOT unbacked — the mechanical half lives one layer down and is tested. /cycle is an orchestrator that delegates; it emits no exit code of its own, so there is nothing for the cli-exit oracle to assert against, and asserting one would be the fake-check class this registry exists to catch. What IS enforced: scripts/lib/worktree-identity.mjs::resolveRangeSnapshot refuses a non-ancestor explicit base with reason 'not-an-ancestor', and scripts/openai-audit.mjs re-raises that refusal PAST the catch that would otherwise swallow it into a silent fallback to plan-referenced files — the precise demotion this SKILL line forbids. Pinned by tests/audit-base-ancestry.test.mjs (against a real diverged ref) and tests/diff-base-resolver.test.mjs (injected runner). So the SKILL prose is the first of two layers and says so; the second layer is where the exit code is. Added 2026-08-11 under docs/plans/worktree-identity-guards.md Phase 5.

'Under [HALT] a P0 blocks ship until fixed' delegates to the preview-gate seam (cross-skill.mjs preview-gate) whose decision is a tested function, but /cycle enacts the halt by ORCHESTRATION — it reads the directive and chooses not to ship. There is no /cycle CLI exit code; /cycle is an orchestrator invoking other skills, so the halt is agent flow, not a mechanical exit a cli-exit recipe can assert.

'fix-gate: yes → reach /audit-code convergence (HIGH==0 && MEDIUM<=2 && quickFix==0) before the next cluster builds on it' is the SAME predicate audit-code's contracted convergence-threshold gate already binds. /cycle enforces it by orchestration (it runs /audit-code and reads the verdict), so there is no separate /cycle exit code — the executable binding lives in audit-code's contract, and /cycle's use of it is document-only.

'AUDIT_AUTHOR_TIER_HINT is observation-only — /cycle records it, never routes on it, no wrong tier hint has any execution impact' is a NEGATIVE guarantee (no routing code reads it to change which model runs). Asserting an absence-of-routing is a source-graph negative with no cli-exit binding; there is no router to exercise. Document-only.

'The consolidated Gemini gate is mandatory after clustered execution, regardless of per-cluster convergence' is an orchestration invariant /cycle enacts by always running the union-diff Gemini review. No /cycle CLI, no exit code — the mandatory-ness is agent flow the model performs, not a mechanical gate.
